get.description:
Reached on a previous hostname (lyric.tjia.dev, lyrics.tjia.dev — Caddy sends
every request there). Cookies are per host, so without this every browser, the car
included, would have to sign in again after the move to PUBLIC_BASE_URL. If this
browser has a session here, carry it over with a single-use token.

put.description:
The reader's vote on whether the track is Cantonese (decides it for them, counts
once for everyone else); answers with its lyrics as they now see them.

get.description: The search screen: songs matching free text, from every source.

delete.description: Revoke the token this request carries: a receiver being uninstalled.

post.description:
A few seconds of sound from the user's microphone → the song and where it was
when the recording started. The audio goes to AudD with the user's own key and is
not stored.

feed_selected.title: Feed Selected
feed_selected.description: The user's screens show the feed (Settings → Now playing from); false = pushes are kept but not shown.

FeedMe.title: FeedMe
FeedMe.description:
What a token is (GET /api/feed/v1/me): for a receiver to check its token and
whether the user's screens will show what it pushes.

duration_ms.title: Duration Ms
duration_ms.description: Strongly recommended: lets DriveLyrics ask for the next track right after this one ends.

position_ms.title: Position Ms
position_ms.description: Playback position; omitted on a new track = 0.

source.title: Source
source.description: Shown to the user only, e.g. "Spotify", "Bluetooth".

measured_at.title: Measured At
measured_at.description: Unix ms when position_ms was read; ignored when more than 5 minutes off the server clock.

fetch_id.title: Fetch Id
fetch_id.description: The id of the fetch event this answers, if any.

FeedPush.title: FeedPush
FeedPush.description: What is playing right now, pushed by the user's side (POST /api/feed/v1/now-playing).

watching.title: Watching
watching.description: A DriveLyrics screen of this user is open.

next_fetch_in_ms.title: Next Fetch In Ms
next_fetch_in_ms.description: When DriveLyrics would next ask for an update; null = no update needed.

FeedPushAck.title: FeedPushAck
FeedPushAck.description: For clients that don't listen to events: when to push next, if at all.

LinkInfo.title: LinkInfo
LinkInfo.description: A pending link, as the approval page shows it.

token.title: Token
token.description: With approved: the new feed token, handed out this once.

client_name.title: Client Name
client_name.description: Becomes the token's name, e.g. "Home Assistant".

LinkStart.title: LinkStart
LinkStart.description: Ask to be linked to someone's account without a token (POST /api/feed/v1/link).

verify_url.title: Verify Url
verify_url.description: Where the user approves, with the code filled in.

poll_secret.title: Poll Secret
poll_secret.description: Keep it to yourself; poll with it.

interval_s.title: Interval S
interval_s.description: Poll no more often than this.

MeResponse.title: MeResponse
MeResponse.description:
200 even when signed out (user = null): loading the page is not a failed login,
so it must not produce the 401s fail2ban counts (see ~/projects/AGENTS.md).

PreferencesUpdate.title: PreferencesUpdate
PreferencesUpdate.description:
All fields optional — PATCH-style partial update. `None` means "leave as is",
which is why these can't just reuse PreferencesResponse's non-optional fields.

FetchEvent.description: Read the player once and push the result.

reason.description: Informational; treat every fetch the same. New reasons may be added within v1.
reason.title: Reason

FetchEvent.title: FetchEvent

PingEvent.description: Sent by the "Test" button in settings; needs no answer.
PingEvent.title: PingEvent

StopEvent.description: No screen is open any more: no fetches until the next "opened".
StopEvent.title: StopEvent

FeedEvent.description: One event, on the event stream (GET /api/feed/v1/events) or as a webhook body.
FeedEvent.title: FeedEvent
